candidates.headline: SECP suspends proposed acquisition of Al Shaheer Corporation (ASCNC)
candidates.summary: Per Mettis Global's latest-news feed: SECP suspended the proposed acquisition of voting shares and control of Al Shaheer Corporation Limited (PSX: ASCNC). This is the acquisition first publicly announced 2026-06-30 (Muhammad Farrukh/Unity Packages proposing to buy a 53.5% stake, 200.60m shares, via AKD Securities as manager, per Business Recorder) - SECP has now suspended that process; reason for suspension not detailed in the source reviewed this cycle. Logged as impact 4 (regulatory action) per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10); escalation flagged.
